يتعايوا (form VI)
# يَتَعَايَوْا (yataʕāyaw) /ja.ta.ʕaː.jaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
# يُتَعَايَوْا (yutaʕāyaw) /ju.ta.ʕaː.jaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
